why: a declared sweep kills a rival's remote bodies that run from it at sight, keeping each in reach once it is, rather than trailing it a tile behind; `sweepKept` bounds that chase alone, and a body that runs to a gate is not chased there (owner, 2026-10-20). `sweepKept` reads the prey's steps alone, so how many prey were shot standing, which the spawn's order decides, does not move it (#812). A hunt reads a prey that stood last tick as staying, so one stepping every other tick leaves reach on each step: main keeps 27/39/25 over seeds 1-3, and a hunt reading such a prey as free to step keeps 94/80/94; the bound sits under main's seeds (#812)
